issue.title: Guided bank category-key rename/merge and account alias rename migrations

task_type_fields.proposal:
Plan a guarded v2 migration flow for the bank: config's history-bearing edits, which v1 refuses on purpose: category-key rename and merge (`category.rename {key, to}`, `category.merge {from, into}`), and account alias rename (`account.rename {alias, to}`). Each op previews complete-scan counts (month-note rows via `[cat::]` / `[acct::]`, rule `cat` refs, subscription records' `category`, and bank journal import/transaction events). It rewrites every affected row span byte-for-byte (album restore-span precedent), plus the `bank:` entry, rules, and subscription records, in one `host_catalog::run_locked` transaction with one scoped commit and a reversible normal-edit inverse. Stale or unsafe inputs refuse atomically.

Today `bob bank config update` (bob-cli `src/native/bank/config_update/ops.rs`) refuses these edits with `account_alias_immutable`, `account_migration`, and `category_in_use`, plus counts and the Ctrl+E YAML path. The Bank Setup card (bob-plugins `248i`/`248k`) shows the edits but refuses them with "wait for a migration flow". Keep JavaScript presentation-only: the Setup card only stages these ops and paints bob's consequence lines.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Proposed by the plan:202611/bank_setup_render_and_edit.md "Integration and land-agent acceptance" item 4 and triaged by the bob-cli-lt land agent. The approved bob-cli-lt v1 lists category-key rename/merge and account alias rename as out of scope by design ("each refused edit is refused with a taught alternative, never half-implemented"), so this is deferred capability, not an unresolved v1 defect. Size large: rewriting rows across month notes, journals, and subscription records in one guarded transaction needs its own plan. Related: bob-cli-lz is the album analogue (field.rename/choice.merge). Coordinate any shared span-rewrite extraction with it.

issue.creation_reason: The bank setup epic (bob-cli-lt) deliberately refuses history-bearing config edits and its plan asks the land agent to file the deferred v2 migration flow so it is tracked.

payload.description: Album analogue of the same guarded span-preserving migration; share any rewrite extraction
